blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Bias has long been studied in social psychology and cognitive science, where decades of research have produced a body of validated interventions that reduce stereotypical thinking and prejudiced responses in humans. We propose DebiasItYourself (DIY), a cognitively grounded framework that translates five such interventions into debiasing procedures for large language models and delivers them through three established paradigms, Show (in-context examples), Train (instruction tuning), and Revise (guided self-revision). Across three models, five bias benchmarks, eleven debiasing baselines, and three reasoning benchmarks, Train+Revise and Revise alone attain the top two average ranks, lead the bias–reasoning tradeoff (mean bias as low as 2 % 2\% at 90 % 90\% reasoning accuracy), and reduce bias on unseen dimensions by up to 14.8 % 14.8\% . Our code and data are publicly available. 1 1 1 https://github.com/chahatraj/DebiasItYourself
blocks.zh: 偏见早已在社会心理学和认知科学中被研究,数十年的研究产生了一套有效的干预措施,减少了人类的陈规定型思维和偏见反应. 我们提出DebiasIt Yourself(DIY),这是一个基于认知的框架,将5个此类干预转化为大型语言模型的脱轨程序,并通过三个既定范例加以提供,即Show(文本中的例子)、Train(教程调整)和Review(指南自译自审)。 纵观三种模式,五种偏差基准,十一种偏差基线,以及三种推理基准,Train+Revise和Review单独达到前两个平均排名,引导偏差 — — 理性权衡(平均偏差为2% 2% — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — 我们的代码和数据可公开查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “Prejudice is a habit that can be broken” ( Devine et al., 2012 ) . Bias is not eliminated by awareness or restraint, but by deliberate cognitive practices that change how social information is processed when it is encountered. Decades of research in social psychology and cognitive science have empirically validated such practices in humans, showing that they specify what to attend to in a situation that invites a stereotyped response, what assumption to override, and what alternative to produce ( Allport, 1954 ; Devine et al., 2012 ; Galinsky and Moskowitz, 2000 ) . They are taught to people, practiced over time, and assessed for sustained change in behavior.
blocks.zh: “偏见是一种可以打破的习惯”(Devine等人,2012年)。 偏见不是通过意识或约束消除的,而是通过有意的认知做法消除的,这些认知做法改变了遇到社会信息时处理方式. 社会心理学和认知科学的数十年研究从经验上验证了人类的这类做法,表明它们具体规定了在引起定型反应的情况下应处理什么问题、何种假设可以推翻以及可产生何种替代办法(Allport,1954年;Devine等人,2012年;Galinsky和Moskowitz,2000年)。 它们被传授给人们,在一段时间内进行实践,并被评估为行为的持续改变.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example of a cognitive bias-reduction intervention using counter-stereotypical imaging.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 使用反定型成像的认知偏差减少干预的例子.

blocks.en: Bias in large language models is a well-documented harm ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ; Caliskan et al., 2017 ; Blodgett et al., 2020 ; Sheng et al., 2019 ; Parrish et al., 2022 ) , and a growing body of work has sought to mitigate it through debiased embeddings ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ; Zhao et al., 2018 ) , counterfactual augmentation ( Zmigrod et al., 2019 ; Lu et al., 2020 ) , prompt-based steering ( Schick et al., 2021 ; Ganguli et al., 2023 ) , fairness-aware training ( Liang et al., 2020 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) , and decoding-time constraints ( Schick et al., 2021 ) . These efforts have made measurable progress, but they have largely developed in isolation from the decades of psychological research on how bias is reduced in humans. Translating empirically validated cognitive interventions into language-model behavior is not just a question of whether they work, but a chance to ground bias mitigation in established theory of bias reduction, surface which forms of cognitive practices are most effective in language models, and open a research direction in which methods of debiasing can be systematically derived rather than ad hoc designed.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型中的比阿斯是一个有据可查的伤害(Bolukbasi等人,2016年;Caliskan等人,2017年;Blodgett等人,2020年;Sheng等人,2019年;Parrish等人,2022年),越来越多的工作试图通过非偏见嵌入来减轻它(Bolukbasi等人,2016年;赵等人,2018年),反事实增强(Zmigrod等人,2019年;Lu等人,2020年),即时引导(Schick等人,2021年;Ganguli等人,2023年),公平意识培训(Liang等人,2020年;Bai等人,2022年),以及解码时间限制。 (Schick等人,2021年). 这些努力已经取得了可衡量的进展,但它们在很大程度上是在与几十年的关于人类如何减少偏见的心理研究隔绝的情况下发展起来的. 将经经验验证的认知干预转换为语言模型行为,不仅仅是它们是否起作用的问题,而是在既定的减少偏差理论中将偏差减轻到地上的机会,表面的认知实践形式在语言模型中最为有效,并开启了一种研究方向,在这个方向上,去偏差的方法可以系统推导,而不是临时设计.

blocks.en: We present DebiasItYourself ( DIY ), a cognitively-grounded approach to debiasing large language models (Figure 1 ). DIY adapts the prejudice habit-breaking framework of Devine et al. (2012) , which integrates five empirically validated cognitive practices for reducing stereotypical thinking: stereotype replacement , counter-stereotypical imaging , individuation , perspective-taking ( Galinsky and Moskowitz, 2000 ) , and positive contact ( Allport, 1954 ) . We translate each strategy into an explicit step-wise procedure the model can apply, and we deliver these procedures to the model through three established paradigms: in-context demonstrations ( Show ), instruction tuning ( Train ), and intervention-guided self-revision ( Revise ). In doing so, DIY treats debiasing as a procedure the model itself can learn and apply rather than a benchmark-specific fix. The three paradigms are intentionally straightforward; our aim is to provide a faithful step toward grounding LLM debiasing in established theory of social psychology and cognitive science.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍DebiasIt Yourself(DIY),这是一种基于认知的方法,用来去除大语言模型(图1)。 DIY调整了Devine等人(2012年)的偏见打破习惯框架,其中整合了五个经验性验证的认知做法,以减少陈规定型思维:定型观念的替换、反定型成像、二分法、取景(Galinsky和Moskowitz,2000年)和积极接触(Allport,1954年)。 我们把每个战略转化为一个明确的渐进程序,模式可以适用,我们通过三个既定的范例向模式提供这些程序:内文演示(显示)、指令调整(列车)和干预指导自译自审(修订)。 在这样做时,DIY将调试视为一种程序,模型本身可以学习和应用,而不是特定基准的固定方法。 这三种范式是有意直截了当的;我们的目标是提供一个忠实的步骤,使LLM在既定的社会心理学和认知科学理论中脱落。

blocks.en: We evaluate DIY on three models from two families at three scales, five bias benchmarks, eleven existing debiasing baselines spanning prompt-based, training-based, and inference-based families, and three reasoning benchmarks. The two top-ranked methods across bias benchmarks are both DIY configurations: Train-Revise and self-revision Revise alone. They also lead the bias–reasoning tradeoff, achieving mean bias as low as 2 % 2\% at 90 % 90\% reasoning accuracy, and they transfer to unseen bias dimensions, reaching a reduction of up to 14.8 14.8 percentage points. We make the following three contributions:
blocks.zh: 我们从两个家庭按三个尺度对DIY进行三个模型的评价,五个偏差基准,11个跨越迅速、培训和基于推论的家庭的现有去偏差基线,以及三个推理基准。 横跨偏见基准的两种排名最高的方法都是DIY配置:Train-Revise和自译自审修订。 它们也引领着偏见 — — 理性的权衡,以90%的90 % 推理精度达到2%的2% — — 达到平均偏差,并转移到隐形偏差维度,达到14.8 14.8 个百分点的下降。 我们作出以下三项贡献:

blocks.en: 1. We propose a psychology-grounded framework for translating cognitive bias-reduction strategies into debiasing procedures for language models, mapping five strategies from social psychology onto three established learning paradigms ( Show , Train , Revise ). 2. We implement the five cognitive strategies and evaluate them against eleven existing debiasing methods on 5 bias and 3 reasoning benchmarks, across model families, scales, and bias dimensions. We release the accompanying intervention dataset to support future work. 3. We show that the proposed cognitive interventions reduce bias more effectively than the existing debiasing methods on average, transfer to unseen bias dimensions, and preserve general reasoning ability across models, suggesting that cognitively-grounded bias mitigation is a promising direction for future work.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: We organize related work along: NLP debiasing methods, NLP studies that draw on psychology, and the social-psychology literature on bias reduction.
blocks.zh: 我们组织相关的工作: NLP 解析方法, NLP 研究借鉴心理学, 社会心理学文献 关于减少偏差。

blocks.en: Existing work falls into four families. Representation-level methods debias learned embeddings or sentence representations ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ; Liang et al., 2020 ) . Data-centric methods augment training with counterfactual or balanced examples ( Zmigrod et al., 2019 ; Lu et al., 2020 ) . Inference-time methods prompt or self-correct toward fairer outputs. And alignment-based methods incorporate human or model-derived preferences during training ( Bai et al., 2022 ) . Across these families, methods are typically tuned to a particular benchmark or social dimension, and improvements often reflect changes to the model’s outputs on the benchmark it was tuned for. Standard bias benchmarks themselves score the model’s outputs: stereotype-pair preferences ( Nangia et al., 2020 ; Nadeem et al., 2021 ) , ambiguous QA ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , counterfactual coreference ( Zhao et al., 2018 ; Rudinger et al., 2018 ) , and bias in generation ( Nozza et al., 2021 ; Smith et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有工作分为四个家庭。 代表级方法debias学习嵌入式或句子表达法(Bolukbasi等人,2016年;梁等人,2020年). 以数据为中心的方法用反事实或平衡的例子加强培训(Zmigrod等人,2019年;Lu等人,2020年)。 推论时间方法迅速或自我纠正,实现更公平的产出。 以调整为基础的方法包括培训期间的人的偏好或模式产生的偏好(Bai等人,2022年)。 在整个这些家庭中,方法通常都适应特定的基准或社会层面,改进往往反映模型产出在它所选择的基准上的变化。 标准偏差基准本身对该模型的产出评分:定型偏好(Nangia等人,2020年;Nadeem等人,2021年),模棱两可。 QA(Parrish等人,2022年),反事实coference(赵等人,2018年;Rudinger等人,2018年),以及世代偏倚(Nozza等人,2021年;Smith等人,2022年).

blocks.en: A smaller line of work borrows psychology-inspired strategies. Self-debiasing prompts a model to suppress its own biased generations ( Schick et al., 2021 ) , moral self-correction uses instruction-following to elicit fairer responses ( Ganguli et al., 2023 ) , Raj et al. (2024) apply the contact hypothesis to debias LLMs, and Xu et al. (2024) use perspective-taking prompts. Each of these works draws on a single strategy, and the connection to social-psychology research on prejudice reduction has remained largely thematic.
blocks.zh: 较小的一行工作借用了心理学启发的策略. 自我贬低会促使一个模型压制自己有偏见的几代人(Schick等人,2021年),道德自我矫正会使用指令跟踪来引起更公平的响应(Ganguli等人,2023年),Raj等人(2024年)将接触假说应用于去比亚斯LLMs,许等人. (2024)使用透视提示. 这些作品都采用了单一的战略,与减少偏见的社会-心理学研究的联系基本上仍然是专题性的。

blocks.en: Bias reduction in humans has been studied empirically for decades. Allport (1954) established that structured intergroup contact reduces prejudice, Galinsky and Moskowitz (2000) showed that perspective-taking reduces stereotype expression, and Devine et al. (2012) integrated these and related findings into a habit-breaking intervention based on five practices, with reductions in implicit race bias sustained over time. The consistent finding across this literature is that bias is reduced by changing how social information is processed at the moment of encounter, not by suppressing individual responses. DIY draws on five complementary interventions grounded in Devine et al. (2012) and studies them under three established learning approaches in language models, evaluating across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 几十年来,人类的偏见减少问题一直得到实证研究。 Allport(1954年)规定,有组织的群体间接触减少了偏见,Galinsky和Moskowitz(2000年)表明,取景减少了定型观念的表达方式,Devine等人(2012年)将这些结论和相关结论纳入基于五种做法的打破习惯的干预中,并逐渐减少隐含的种族偏见。 这些文献的一致结论是,通过改变在遇到时处理社会信息的方式,而不是压制个人的反应,减少了偏见。 DIY借鉴了基于Devine等人(2012年)的5项补充性干预措施,并根据三种既定的语言模式学习方法对其进行研究,并进行跨基准评价。

blocks.en: 3 The DIY Framework
blocks.zh: 3 DIY框架

blocks.en: We describe the five cognitive bias-reduction interventions drawn from social psychology, and the data that instantiate them as biased–debiased pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们把从社会心理学中提取的五种认知偏差减少干预, 以及将他们当做偏差-偏差对的数据。

blocks.en: 3.1 Bias-Reducing Interventions
blocks.zh: 3.1 减少偏见干预

blocks.en: We draw on the prejudice habit-breaking framework of Devine et al. (2012) , which integrates five cognitive interventions empirically validated in social psychology to reduce stereotypical thinking with sustained effects. Each intervention targets a distinct route through which stereotypes enter reasoning and we specify them as an explicit three-step procedure, which makes it directly applicable as model-facing input. Interventions can be applied independently or in combination.
blocks.zh: 我们借鉴了Devine等人(2012年)的偏见破除习惯框架,其中整合了在社会心理学中经经验验证的五项认知干预,以减少具有持续影响的陈规定型思维。 每一次干预都针对一种独特的途径,通过这种途径,陈规定型进入推理过程,我们将其规定为明确的三步程序,从而直接作为模型投入适用。 干预措施可以独立实施或组合实施。

blocks.en: This intervention disrupts biased reasoning by identifying a stereotype and substituting a fairer, individualized interpretation. It proceeds in three steps: (i) Recognize whether a stereotype or bias is being invoked, (ii) Reflect on why the stereotype may be inaccurate, overgeneralized, or harmful, and (iii) Replace the biased assumption with a neutral or evidence-based alternative. The aim is not to suppress reasoning, but to redirect it away from group-based generalizations.
blocks.zh: 这种干预通过确定陈规定型并取代更公平、个性化的解释,破坏了有偏见的推理。 它分三个步骤进行:(一) 承认是否在援引定型观念或偏见;(二) 思考为什么定型观念可能不准确、过于笼统或有害;(三) 以中立或基于证据的替代办法取代偏见的假设。 目的不是压制推理,而是将其从基于集团的概括中转向.

blocks.en: This intervention strengthens associations that contradict prevailing stereotypes. It proceeds with: (i) Recognize whether a stereotype is being invoked, (ii) Imagine a real or hypothetical individual who defies the stereotype, and (iii) Reinforce the alternative by elaborating concrete details about the counter-stereotypical example. Reinforcing such alternatives weakens the activation of stereotypical beliefs during reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这种干预加强了与普遍存在的定型观念相矛盾的社团。 它的出发点是:(一) 承认是否在援引定型观念,(二) 想象一个真实的或假想的人来反驳定型观念,(三) 通过详细阐明反定型观念的例子来加强替代办法。 强化这种替代方法削弱了推理过程中陈规定型信仰的激活。

blocks.en: This intervention shifts attention from social categories to individual-specific information. It proceeds in three steps: (i) Attend to the individual rather than the social group, (ii) Gather individuating details such as personal traits, behaviors, or context, and (iii) Adjust the initial judgment in light of those details. The result is case-specific reasoning rather than category-based inference.
blocks.zh: 这种干预将注意力从社会类别转移到个人信息。 它分三个步骤进行:(一) 关注个人而不是社会群体,(二) 收集个人特征、行为或背景等分散的细节,(三) 根据这些细节调整初步判断。 结果是具体案例推理而不是基于类别推论.

blocks.en: Table 1: The five DIY configurations. IT = instruction tuning, ICL = in-context learning, Revise = intervention-guided second pass. Takeaway: configurations cover single components and their two-component compositions, isolating each contribution.
blocks.zh: 表1: 五个DIY配置. IT=指令调试,ICL=内文学习,Review=干预指导二次通过. Takeaway:配置涵盖单个组件及其两个组件组成,将每个贡献隔离.

blocks.en: This intervention has the model take the viewpoint of the person being stereotyped. It proceeds in three steps: (i) Adopt the perspective of the targeted individual, (ii) Simulate the thoughts, feelings, or experiences they may have in the situation, and (iii) Integrate that perspective into the final response. Foregrounding lived experience reframes bias and promotes more context-aware reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这种干预模式以个人被定型为观点。 它分三个步骤进行:(一) 从目标个人的角度出发,(二) 模拟他们在局势中可能拥有的思想、感情或经验,(三) 将这一角度纳入最后对策。 前期经验重新塑造了偏见,并促进了更多了解背景的推理。

blocks.en: This intervention draws on contact theory, which holds that meaningful positive interactions reduce prejudice Allport (1954) . It proceeds in three steps: (i) Recall a constructive interaction with a member of the stereotyped group, (ii) Engage with the interaction by describing what was shared, learned, or felt, and (iii) Extend the experience to challenge the original stereotype. The emphasis is on affective engagement rather than factual correction alone.
blocks.zh: 这种干预借鉴了接触理论,该理论认为,有意义的积极互动减少偏见Allport(1954年)。 它分三个步骤进行:(一) 回顾与某一定型群体成员的建设性互动;(二) 通过描述分享、学习或感觉来参与互动;(三) 扩大经验以挑战原有的定型。 重点是积极接触,而不仅仅是事实纠正。

blocks.en: 3.2 DIY Dataset Creation
blocks.zh: 3.2 调查 数据集创建

blocks.en: Figure 2: Per-intervention comparison on Llama -3.1-8B: bias mitigation, reasoning accuracy, and held-out-dimension generalization. Shaded bands show the baseline envelope. Takeaway: all five interventions are competitive across all three axes.
blocks.zh: 图2:对Llama-3.1-8B的干预比较:减少偏差、推理精度和持有偏差一般化。 阴影带显示基线信封. 外卖:所有5种干预措施都具有三轴竞争力。

blocks.en: To adapt the underlying cognitive strategies to a model, we need data on which the procedure can be applied at training or inference time. We therefore construct an intervention-labeled corpus of biased–debiased pairs : each biased input is a stereotype-invoking statement directed at an identity, and each debiased output is a step-by-step application of one of the five cognitive interventions to that input. The resulting data supports both supervised instruction tuning ( Train ) and inference-time in-context demonstrations ( Show ).
blocks.zh: 为了使基本的认知战略适应一个模型,我们需要数据,在培训或推断时间可以应用有关程序。 因此,我们构建了一个带有干预标签的带有偏见的对称体:每一种带有偏见的输入都是针对一个身份的刻板印象,而每一种带有偏见的输出都是将五个认知干预之一一步一步地应用到这种输入中。 由此产生的数据既支持有监督的指令调谐(列车),也支持推断时间的文本演示(显示)。

blocks.en: A biased input is realized in three textual forms: an opinion (a direct biased statement, e.g., “All [identity] are dishonest” ), a biased action (a sentence in which the opinion drives a discriminatory behavior), and a biased event (a sentence describing an event that leads to forming the opinion). Examples and the full biased-input-form schema are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 一种有偏见的输入以三种文字形式实现:一种意见(一种直接有偏见的声明,例如“所有[身份]都是不诚实的”)、一种有偏见的行动(一种意见驱使歧视行为的句子)和一种有偏见的事件(一种描述导致形成意见的事件的句子)。 附录C载有实例和完整的有偏见的投入形式计划。

blocks.en: Identity descriptors are drawn from HolisticBias ( Smith et al., 2022 ) ; the bias dimensions match those covered by BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) . The corpus covers nine dimensions: disability, age, gender, race/ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, physical appearance, and socioeconomic status.
blocks.zh: 身份描述词来自HolisticBias(Smith等人,2022年);偏差维度与BBQ(Parrish等人,2022年)覆盖的维度相符. 人身保护包括九个方面:残疾、年龄、性别、种族/族裔、国籍、宗教、性取向、外貌和社会经济地位。

blocks.en: Given the identity descriptors, we generate bias concepts Pan et al. (2025) that reflect commonly observed stereotypical traits, assumptions, or associations (e.g., perceived competence, socioeconomic status, athletic ability). These concepts are not ground-truth claims about any group; they are stereotype-eliciting templates used to build bias-prone inputs in the next step.
blocks.zh: 鉴于身份描述,我们产生了Pan等人(2025年)的偏见概念,这些概念反映了普遍观察到的陈规定型特征、假设或协会(例如,所认为的能力、社会经济地位、运动能力)。 这些概念并不是对任何群体的地面真实说法;而是用来在下一步建立容易产生偏见的投入的刻板印象。

blocks.en: For each (identity, bias concept) pair, a language model instantiates the concept as a natural-language statement, action, or event in one of ten everyday scenarios (art and leisure, economics, education, environment, healthcare, law and policy, media, sports, technology, workplace). The output of this step is the biased side of a biased–debiased pair.
blocks.zh: 对于每一对(身份、偏见概念),一个语言模型将这一概念作为自然语言声明、行动或事件在十种日常情景(艺术和休闲、经济、教育、环境、保健、法律和政策、媒体、体育、技术、工作场所)中的一种。 这个步骤的输出是偏颇的一对偏颇的一面.

blocks.en: For each biased instance, a debiased counterpart is produced by applying one of the five cognitive interventions through its three steps (Section 3.1 ) using Llama -3.3-70B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个有偏见的事例,通过使用Llama -3.3-70B-指示,通过三个步骤(第3.1节)应用五个认知干预之一,产生一个非偏见对应物。

blocks.en: 4 Implementation
blocks.zh: 4 执行

blocks.en: DIY brings the cognitive interventions of Section 3.1 to a language model in three complementary ways: Show , Train , and Revise .
blocks.zh: DIY将第3.1节的认知干预以三种互补方式引入语言模式:显示、列车和修订。

blocks.en: At inference, the chosen intervention and a biased–debiased example pair (worked through the intervention’s three steps) are placed in the prompt as an in-context example. The model conditions on the example and produces a debiased response under the same step structure, without parameter updates. We evaluate Show per intervention, running each of the five as a separate condition, and additionally report an All-strategies aggregation that lets the model choose a strategy on its own.
blocks.zh: 推论,所选择的干预和带有偏见的一对例子(通过干预的三个步骤进行)被放在即时中,作为内在的例子。 模型条件在示例上,并在相同的阶梯结构下产生非偏颇反应,没有参数更新. 我们评价每个干预, 运行其中的每一个作为一个单独的条件, 并另外报告一个全方位战略汇总, 让模型自行选择一个策略。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Average rank across the five bias benchmarks per model. Lower is better. Takeaway: DIY-Train-Revise and DIY-Revise attain the top two ranks on every model, ahead of all baselines.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个模型五个偏差基准的平均排名。 低点更好 Takeaway:DIY - Train - Revise和DIY - Revise在每个型号上取得前两名,领先于所有基线.

blocks.en: The intervention-labeled biased–debiased pairs are converted into instruction-tuning targets and used to fine-tune the model with parameter-efficient adaptation. After training, the model can apply the intervention without explicit demonstrations or intervention text in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 带有干预标签的偏差-偏差对子被转换成指令调试目标,并用来以参数效率的调整来微调模型. 经培训后,该模式可立即实施干预,而无需明确演示或干预文本。

blocks.en: The model first produces an unconstrained response to the input, then applies a selected intervention to its own response by following the same three steps; the revised response replaces the first. As with Show , Revise is evaluated per intervention and in the All-strategies aggregation. When Revise is composed with Train ( DIY-Train-Revise ), the revision pass runs on both the fine-tuned and the base model, separating the contribution of training from that of intervention-guided revision. When Show is composed with Train ( DIY-Train-Show ), the in-context demonstrations are drawn from the same intervention the model was trained on.
blocks.zh: 该模型首先产生对输入的不受约束的响应,然后通过遵循相同的三个步骤,对自己的响应实施选定的干预;修改后的响应取代第一个. 与Show一样,每个干预措施和所有战略汇总都对修订进行评价。 当修订由Train(DIY-Train-Revise)组成时,修订证同时适用经过调整的模式和基准模式,将培训的贡献与干预指导的修订区分开来。 当Show由Train(DIY-Train-Show)组成时,内文演示来自该模型所训练的相同干预.

blocks.en: The approaches differ in how the intervention reaches the model sharing the same input format. All draw on the intervention-labeled data of Section 3.2 ; any combination of Show , Train , and Revise operates over the same five interventions.
blocks.zh: 干预措施如何到达共享相同输入格式的模型,方法不同。 所有这些都利用了第3.2节的干预标记数据;Show、Train和Review的组合在同样的5个干预中运作。

blocks.en: We evaluate DIY across the cells of the Show × Train × Revise \textsc{Show}\times\textsc{Train}\times\textsc{Revise} space, naming each configuration by the approaches it activates. Single-approach configurations are DIY-Train (instruction tuning), DIY-Show (in-context demonstrations), and DIY-Revise (guided self-revision). Two-approach configurations are DIY-Train-Show (training with demonstrations) and DIY-Train-Revise (training with revision). The unmodified baseline is Base . For every DIY configuration with a prompt component, we run 0-shot and 1-shot variants, where the shot count is the number of in-context demonstrations of the selected intervention.
blocks.zh: 我们通过 Show × Train × 修改\ textsc{ 显示\ times\ textsc{ Train\ times\textsc{ Revise} 的单元格来评价 DIY 空间, 按其激活的方法命名每个配置 。 单程配置为DIY-Train(指令调试),DIY-Show(内装演示),DIY-Revise(指导自译自审). 双途径配置为DIY-Train-Show(以示范方式进行的培训)和DIY-Train-Revise(以修订方式进行的培训). 未修改的基准是Base。 对于每个带有即时组件的DIY配置,我们运行0-shot和1-shot的变体,其中的射击计数是选定干预的内文本演示数.

blocks.en: We train three adapter families per model: five intervention-specific adapters pooled across the three biased-input forms, three form-specific adapters pooled across all interventions, and one all-intervention/all-form adapter. Each reported run for Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama -3.3-70B-Instruct, and Qwen 3.5-27B uses rank 64 64 , α = 128 \alpha=128 , batch size 1 1 , gradient accumulation 16 16 , maximum sequence length 2048 2048 , 90 90 optimization steps, and a training set containing 500 500 debiasing examples plus another 100 100 Alpaca-Cleaned examples.
blocks.zh: 我们每个模式培训三个适应者家庭:五个针对干预的适应者集合在三种有偏见的投入形式中,三个针对形式适应者集合在所有干预中,一个针对所有干预/所有形式适应者。 每个报告运行Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct,Llama -3.3-70B-Instruct,和Quen 3.5-27B使用第64位64,α = 128\alpha=128,批量尺寸1 1,梯度积累16 16,最大序列长度2048 2048,90 90 优化步骤,以及包含500 500个除籍实例加上100个阿尔帕卡清除实例的培训集.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验结果

blocks.en: We evaluate DebiasItYourself on Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama -3.3-70B-Instruct, and Qwen 3.5-27B, using five bias benchmarks: CrowS-Pairs ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) , StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) , BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , WinoBias ( Zhao et al., 2018 ) , and WinoGender ( Rudinger et al., 2018 ) ; and three reasoning benchmarks: Balanced COPA ( Kavumba et al., 2019 ) , ARC-Challenge, and ARC-Easy ( Clark et al., 2018 ) . We compare against eleven prior debiasing methods spanning three families. Prompt-based methods elicit fairer responses through prompt engineering: SelfDebias ( Gallegos et al., 2025 ) and RSB ( Kamruzzaman and Kim, 2025 ) . Training-based methods modify model parameters: DebiasNLG ( Wang and Demberg, 2024 ) , DebiasLLMs ( Dong et al., 2024 ) , PEFT ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , DPO ( Dai et al., 2025 ) , LFTF ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , and BiasEdit ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Inference-based methods steer or correct outputs at decoding time: FairSteer ( Li et al., 2025 ) , CAL ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , and BBA ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . Implementation details for DebiasItYourself are in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们对DebiasIt yourself在Llama-3.1-8B-Instructionct、Llama-3.3-70B-Instructionct和Quen 3.5-27B的评价,使用5种偏差基准:CrowS-Pairs(Nangia等人,2020年),StreoSet(Nadeem等人,2021年),BBQ (Parrish等人,2022年),维诺比亚斯. (Zhao等人,2018年),和Wino Gender(Rudinger等人,2018年)三个推理基准: 平衡COPA(Kavumba等人,2019年),ARC-Challenge和ARC-Easy(Clark等人,2018年). 我们比较了以前涉及三个家庭的11个拆分方法。 即时方法通过即时工程得到更公平的响应:Self Debias(Gallegos等人,2025年)和RSB(Kamruzzaman和Kim,2025年)。 基于培训的方法修改模型参数:DebiasNLG(Wang and Demberg,2024),DebiasLLMs(Dong等人,2024),PEFT(Zhao等人,2025),DPO (Dai等人,2025年),LFTF(秦等人,2025年),BiasEdit(徐等人,2025年). 基于推论的方法在解码时引导或纠正输出:FairSteer(Li等人,2025年),CAL(Sun等人,2024年),BBA(Lin等人,2026年). DebiasIt Yourself的执行详情载于附录。

blocks.en: 5.1 Bias Mitigation
blocks.zh: 5.1 减少偏见

Both quantities are lower-is-better. We also use paired bootstrap resampling over evaluation examples as a robustness check; the intervals support the direction of the principal aggregate DIY reductions relative to Base .

blocks.en: On every tested model, the lowest average rank across the five bias benchmarks is achieved by a DIY configuration (Figure 3 ). DIY-Train-Revise leads on Llama -3.1-8B, and DIY-Revise leads on both Qwen 3.5-27B and Llama -3.3-70B. The lead is consistent across model families and scales: intervention-guided revision ( DIY-Revise , DIY-Train-Revise ) occupies the top two slots on every model, with the strongest non- DIY baselines (DebiasLLMs, PEFT, BiasEdit, SelfDebias) trailing the leading DIY configuration on the smaller models and narrowing the gap on Llama -3.3-70B.
blocks.zh: 在每一个测试模型中,五个偏差基准的最低平均排名是通过DIY配置实现的(图3 )。 DIY-Train-Revise领先于Llama-3.1-8B,DIY-Revise领先于Quen 3.5-27B和Llama -3.3-70B. 领先在模型家族和尺度之间是一致的:干预指导修订(DIY-Revise,DIY-Train-Revise)占据每个模型前两个位置,最强的非DIY基线(DebiasLLMs,PEFT,BiasEdit,SelfDebias)在较小模型上排在领先的DIY配置之后,缩小了Llama-3.3-70B上的差距.

blocks.en: Takeaway 1. On every tested model, the best average rank across bias benchmarks is achieved by a DIY configuration, with intervention-guided revision in the top two on every model.
blocks.zh: 外卖 1. 在每一个测试模型中,跨偏差基准的最佳平均排名是通过一个DIY配置实现的,每个模型的前两个模型都有干预指导的修订。

blocks.en: Across the five DIY configurations, intervention-guided revision contributes the largest share of the bias reduction, and combining it with instruction tuning yields the strongest overall configuration (Figure 4 ; Llama -3.3-70B and Qwen 3.5-27B in Appendix Figures 11 – 12 ). DIY-Revise reduces bias substantially across all three models, and composing it with DIY-Train sharpens the reduction further. DIY-Train alone produces a smaller and less consistent reduction, suggesting that parameter-level training is most useful when paired with an inference-time procedure rather than applied in isolation. DIY-Show shows a different pattern: zero-shot demonstrations are competitive with the leading configurations, while adding more demonstrations does not consistently help. Shot effects are technique-dependent more broadly: revision benefits modestly from additional demonstrations, while training-based configurations are largely insensitive to shot count.
blocks.zh: 在5个DIY组合中,干预指导修订对减少偏差的贡献最大,与指令调制相结合,产生最强的总体配置(图4;图3.3-70B和图11-12中的图3.5-27B)。 DIY-Revise大幅降低了所有三种模式的偏差,与DIY-Train的组合进一步强化了这种偏差. 光是DIY-Train就会产生较小和不太一致的削减,这表明参数级培训在与推断时间程序配对而不是孤立适用时最有用。 DIY-Show显示了不同的模式:零镜头演示与领先的配置具有竞争力,而增加更多的演示则无法持续帮助. 射击效果在技术上具有更广泛的依赖性:修订工作从额外的演示中得益不大,而基于培训的配置基本上对射击计数不敏感。

blocks.en: Takeaway 2. Intervention-guided revision is the strongest technique, and pairing it with instruction tuning yields the most reliable configuration. Instruction tuning alone offers limited improvement; in-context examples are most effective at zero-shot.
blocks.zh: 外卖 2. 干预制导修改是最强的技术,与指令调制配对产生最可靠的配置。 单是指令调谐就可提供有限的改进;在零镜头时,文本中的例子最为有效.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Reasoning accuracy on Qwen 3.5-27B across Balanced COPA, ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy. Shaded bands show the baseline min–max (outer) and IQR (inner). Higher is better. Takeaway: every DIY configuration sits at or above the baseline envelope, with some matching or exceeding Base on ARC.
blocks.zh: 图5:平衡COPA、ARC-Challenge、ARC-Easy的Quen 3.5-27B的合理准确性。 阴影波段显示基线 min-max(输出)和IQR(内置). 高点更好 Takeaway:每个DIY配置都坐落在或高于基线信封,在ARC上有一些匹配或超过Base.

blocks.en: Figure 2 reports per-intervention bias mitigation on Llama -3.1-8B against the baseline envelope. All five cognitive interventions and the All-strategies aggregate sit at the high end of the baseline envelope, with bias mitigation values clustered tightly. Counter-stereotypical Imaging and Positive Contact are at the top of the cluster; Stereotype Replacement and the aggregate are slightly behind but within the same band. Differences across interventions are small relative to the gap between any of them and the unmodified Base , indicating that mitigation arises from the cognitive framing as a whole rather than from a single dominant intervention.
blocks.zh: 图2 对照基准信封报告Llama-3.1-8B的干预偏差。 所有五个认知干预和全战略合计都位于基线信封的高端,偏差缓解值集中在一起。 反陈规定型 成像和正接触位于集群的顶端; 立体型置换和集合略落后但在同一波段内. 相对于其中任何一种措施与未经修改的基础之间的差距而言,不同干预措施之间的差别很小,这表明缓解措施来自整个认知框架,而不是单一的主导干预。

blocks.en: 5.2 Reasoning Ability
blocks.zh: 5.2 理性能力

blocks.en: Across all five DIY configurations and both shot settings, reasoning accuracy on Balanced COPA, ARC-Challenge, and ARC-Easy stays at or above the unmodified Base on Qwen 3.5-27B (Figure 5 ; Llama -3.1-8B and Llama -3.3-70B in Appendix Figures 13 – 14 ). Several configurations exceed Base , with DIY-Train-Show and DIY-Train producing the largest gains on ARC. Revision-, training-, and demonstration-based configurations all stay within the same accuracy band, with no degradation from any added training component. The only consistent dip across models is DIY-Show at 1 1 -shot on Balanced COPA, which falls below Base on both Qwen 3.5-27B and Llama -3.1-8B; this aligns with the DIY-Show 1 1 -shot bias-reduction instability noted earlier. Training the model on intervention-guided behavior therefore does not erode general reasoning, and on the larger model can incidentally improve it.
blocks.zh: 在所有五个DIY配置和两个镜头设置中,平衡COPA、ARC-Challenge和ARC-Easy的推理精度都保持在或高于Quen 3.5-27B上的未修改基数(图5;Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.3-70B,附录图13-14)。 多个配置超过Base ,其中DIY-Train-Show和DIY-Train在ARC上产生最大的收益. 修订、培训和示范配置都处于相同的准确度范围内,没有任何新增培训部分的降解。 唯一一致的跨模型的DiY-Show at 1 - shoot on Balanced COPA, 在Quen 3.5-27B和Llama - 3.1-8B上都低于Base;这与前面提到的DiY-Show 1 - Show 1-shot-减少偏差的不稳定性是一致的。 因此,对干预指导行为的模型进行培训不会削弱一般推理,而对于更大的模型可以顺便加以改进。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Bias–reasoning tradeoff: mean bias (x) vs. reasoning accuracy (y). Diamonds are DIY , circles are baselines; top-left is best. Takeaway: DIY occupies the top-left corner on every model.
blocks.zh: 图6:偏差-合理权衡:平均偏差(x)与推理精度(y). 钻石是DIY,圆是基线;左上角是最好的。 Takeaway:DIY占据每个模型的左上角.

blocks.en: Takeaway 3. DIY preserves reasoning accuracy across all configurations and shot settings, with several configurations on Qwen 3.5-27B exceeding the unmodified Base on ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge.
blocks.zh: 外卖 3. DIY保持了所有配置和射击设置的推理精度,Quen 3.5-27B上的几个配置超过了ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上的未修改基础.

blocks.en: A central concern for any debiasing method is that bias reductions should not come at the cost of general task competence. DIY configurations sit on the favorable corner of the bias–reasoning frontier across all three models, achieving low mean bias without the reasoning collapse seen in several baselines (Figure 6 ). On Llama -3.1-8B, DIY-Revise and DIY-Train-Revise reach the lowest mean bias of any method while preserving reasoning accuracy; the strongest baseline at the same bias level (DebiasLLMs) does so only by dropping reasoning sharply. The same pattern holds on Qwen 3.5-27B, where DIY-Train-Revise achieves both the highest reasoning accuracy and a mean bias comparable to the strongest debiasing baselines, while BiasEdit and DebiasLLMs reach low bias only at substantially lower reasoning. On Llama -3.3-70B, DIY-Revise and DIY-Train-Revise again sit in the top-left region, while baselines that match their bias level (DebiasLLMs, BiasEdit) drop to far lower reasoning. One explanation is that methods that lower bias by inducing vague or refusal-style outputs lose the ability to answer task questions correctly, whereas DIY preserves it because the training target is intervention-guided behavior on bias-sensitive input rather than output suppression.
blocks.zh: 任何脱轨方法的主要关切是,减少偏差不应以牺牲一般任务能力为代价。 DIY配置坐落在偏差的有利角落 — — 在所有三种模型中合理边框,实现低平均值偏差,而不会出现几个基线(图6)中看到的推理崩溃。 在Llama -3.1-8B上,DIY-Revise和DIY-Train-Revise在保持推理精度的同时达到了任何方法的最低平均偏差;在同一偏差水平(DebiasLLMs)上最强的基准只能通过急剧下降推理来实现. 同样的图案在Quen 3.5-27B上也存在,其中DIY-Train-Revise既能实现最高推理精度,又能实现与最强的除颤基线相比的均匀偏差,而BiasEdit和DebiasLLM只在大幅降低推理时才达到低偏差. 在Llama -3.3-70B上,DIY-Revise和DIY-Train-Revise再次坐落在左上角区域,而与其偏差水平(DebiasLLMs,BiasEdit)相符的基线则下降到远低推理. 一种解释是,通过诱导模糊或拒绝式输出来降低偏差的方法丧失了正确回答任务问题的能力,而DIY则保留它,因为培训目标是对偏差敏感的输入进行干预指导的行为,而不是抑制输出.

blocks.en: Takeaway 4. DIY sits on the favorable corner of the bias–reasoning frontier on every tested model, supporting the claim that reducing bias as a behavior is compatible with preserving general task competence.
blocks.zh: 外卖 4. DIY站在每个被测试模型的偏差的有利角落 -- -- 理性前沿,支持以下说法:减少偏差作为一种行为是符合保留一般任务能力的。

blocks.en: Figure 2 (middle panel) reports per-intervention reasoning accuracy on Llama -3.1-8B. Every intervention and the All-strategies aggregate land at or above the baseline median, with several above the upper edge of the baseline inter-quartile range. Stereotype Replacement and Individuation reach the highest reasoning accuracy of the five, while Counter-stereotypical Imaging is the lowest, though still inside the baseline envelope. No intervention degrades reasoning relative to Base , supporting the claim that bias mitigation through cognitive interventions does not cost general reasoning ability, consistently across interventions.
blocks.zh: 图2(中间小组)报告Llama-3.1-8B的干预推理精度。 每一次干预和全战略在基线中位数或高于基线中位数,其中数个在基线方程式间范围的上边缘。 立体型置换和异化达到五种中推理精度最高,而反定型成像则最低,虽然仍然在基线信封内. 任何干预都不能降低Base的推理,支持通过认知干预减少偏见不会花费一般推理能力的说法,这种推理在各种干预之间是一致的。

blocks.en: 5.3 Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.3 概论

blocks.en: We test whether DIY transfers beyond the source dimension used for intervention training. In this generalizability run, gender is the source dimension and the columns are evaluation dimensions. Figure 7 reports the percentage reduction in normalized bias error relative to Base for Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct. Positive values indicate lower bias than the base model; improvements outside the gender column measure cross-dimension transfer rather than within-dimension mitigation. This pattern suggests that DIY learns a reusable bias-mitigation procedure rather than only memorizing gender-specific associations.
blocks.zh: 我们检验DIY是否转移超出用于干预培训的来源范围。 在这一普遍性的运行中,性别是来源层面,各栏是评价层面。 图7报告了与Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct相比,正常偏差误差减少的百分比。 正值表明比基准模型的偏差较低;性别栏以外的改进衡量跨离子转移,而不是在离子内部减缓。 这种模式表明,DIY学习一种可重复使用的减轻偏见程序,而不是仅仅纪念与性别有关的协会。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Cross-dimension generalization on Llama -3.1-8B with gender as the source dimension. Cells report % bias reduction over Base . The Gender column measures within-source performance; all other columns measure held-out transfer. Positive values indicate lower bias. Takeaway: bias reduction trained on gender carries over to dimensions unseen during training.

blocks.en: Figure 2 (right panel) reports per-intervention bias mitigation on held-out bias dimensions in the gender-source generalization setting. All five interventions and the All-strategies aggregate yield positive transfer, sitting at the upper end of the baseline on the held-out dimensions. Positive Contact shows the strongest carry-over, followed by Counter-stereotypical Imaging; Stereotype Replacement is the weakest of the five but still positive. blocks.en: Takeaway 5. DIY transfers across bias dimensions: training on one source dimension reduces bias on dimensions never seen during training, with every cognitive intervention producing positive transfer.
blocks.zh: 外卖 5. DIY跨偏见层面的转移:关于一个来源层面的培训减少了培训期间从未见过的对层面的偏见,每个认知干预都会产生积极的转移。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Bias mitigation in language models can be approached as a problem already studied for decades in another field. The DIY framework supports that view: model-facing procedures derived from these interventions improve measured LLM behavior, with guided self-revision producing the most consistent gains and general reasoning ability preserved across configurations. The intervention-labeled dataset we release alongside DIY is a starting point for further work grounded in social-psychology rather than benchmark-specific signals, and we expect more of such literature to translate into model-facing input than is examined here.
blocks.zh: 语文模型中的偏差缓解可被视为另一个领域几十年来已经研究过的问题。 DIY框架支持这一观点:从这些干预中衍生出来的模型造型程序改进了测量的LLM行为,有指导的自译自审产生最一致的收益,并保留了各种配置的一般推理能力. 我们与DIY一起发布的带有干预标签的数据集是进一步基于社会心理学而不是基于具体基准信号的工作的起点,我们期望更多的此类文献转化为模型化输入,而不是在这里审查。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Validated examples of cognitive bias-reduction interventions in social psychology are few and tied to narrow case studies, which is not enough to fine-tune a language model. We address this by generating synthetic intervention-labeled biased–debiased pairs at scale. Artifacts of the prompting model may propagate into the data, and the synthetic distribution may not capture the full breadth of intervention examples a larger human-curated dataset could provide.
blocks.zh: 经验证的社会心理学中认知偏差减少干预的例子很少,而且与狭隘的案例研究有关,这不足以微调语言模型. 我们通过制造大规模合成的带有偏见的干预和偏见的对子来解决这个问题。 催化模型的人工成像可能传播到数据中,而合成分布可能无法捕捉到更大的人精度数据集所能提供的全部干预实例。

blocks.en: The evidence we observe is bias scores on benchmarks. We cannot directly verify whether the model’s underlying processing of social cues has changed or whether the model has become better at producing benchmark-shaped output that scores well under our bias-score formulation. Reasoning preservation provides indirect evidence against pure output suppression, but a direct test of internal processing is outside the scope of this work.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到的证据是基准上的偏差分数。 我们无法直接核实模型的基本社会提示处理是否已经改变,或者模型是否更能产生基准形状的输出,在我们的偏差分数公式下得分。 理性保全提供了防止纯输出抑制的间接证据,但对内部处理的直接检验不属于这项工作的范围.

blocks.en: Our primary bias evaluation uses likelihood, multiple-choice, and pair-ranking benchmarks, and our reasoning evaluation uses commonsense and grade-school science multiple-choice tasks. Appendix I adds open-ended continuation experiments on Regard/NLG-bias and HONEST, but we do not evaluate dialogue or multi-hop reasoning. Claims about preserved task competence and bias reduction remain bounded by these.
blocks.zh: 我们的初级偏差评价采用可能性,多选择,和对等等级的基准,我们的推理评价采用常识和年级科学的多选择任务. 附 录 我加入了关于Regard/NLG-bias和HONEST的开放式继续实验,但我们不评价对话或多跳推理. 关于保留任务能力和减少偏见的主张仍然受到这些限制。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: DIY adapts social-psychology interventions developed for human prejudice reduction into model-facing input. We make no claim that the model engages in bias reduction in the same cognitive sense as a human; we claim only that the procedural form of the interventions is a useful training target for the model. Treating model behavior as analogous to human cognition risks overclaiming and is explicitly disclaimed.
blocks.zh: DIY将为减少人类偏见而开发的社会-心理干预纳入模型化投入。 我们没有声称该模型在与人类相同的认知意义上进行偏差的减少;我们只是声称干预的程序形式是该模型有用的培训目标。 将模型行为视为类似于人类认知风险的过度要求,并明确予以否认。

blocks.en: DIY constructs synthetic biased inputs to train and evaluate mitigation behavior. These examples can reproduce harmful stereotypes if taken out of context, and benchmark gains can create false confidence if the method is deployed outside the evaluated task formats or demographic coverage. We therefore release the dataset as a research artifact for auditing and mitigation, pair biased inputs with debiased targets, document prompts and construction scripts, and discourage use as a stereotype inventory. Downstream users should filter examples for their deployment context.
blocks.zh: DIY构建合成偏颇的投入来训练和评价缓解行为. 这些例子如果脱离上下文,可能再现有害的定型观念,如果在评估的任务格式或人口覆盖范围之外采用这一方法,基准收益就会产生虚假的信心。 因此,我们公布数据集,作为审计和减轻损失的研究成果,将带有偏见的投入与非偏见的目标、文件提示和施工脚本结合起来,并劝阻将数据作为陈规定型清单使用。 下游用户应过滤其部署环境的实例。

blocks.en: Appendix A Strategy Examples

blocks.en: Stereotype Replacement Biased Statement: Women are too emotional to be good leaders. Recognize: This statement relies on a gender stereotype that equates emotional expression with poor leadership ability. Reflect: This generalization is inaccurate and overlooks evidence that emotional intelligence can enhance leadership effectiveness. Replace: Leadership ability depends on skills, experience, and judgment, not someone’s gender.
blocks.zh: 定型替换 带有偏见的声明 : 女人太情绪化了,不能当好领导. 承认: 这种说法依赖于一种性别定型观念,这种定型观念将情感表达等同于领导能力低下。 反射:这种概括是不准确的,忽略了情感智能可以提高领导效能的证据. 替代:领导能力取决于技能、经验和判断,而不是某人的性别。

blocks.en: Counter-Stereotype Imaging Biased Statement: Women are too emotional to be good leaders. Recognize: This statement invokes a stereotype that questions women’s suitability for leadership. Imagine: Consider Jacinda Ardern, former Prime Minister of New Zealand. Reinforce: She demonstrated calm, decisive leadership during major crises while also leading with empathy, contradicting the stereotype.
blocks.zh: 反定型图像偏差声明 : 女人太情绪化了,不能当好领导. 承认: 这种说法引用了一种质疑妇女是否适合担任领导职务的定型观念。 想象:考虑新西兰前总理贾辛达·阿尔登. 强化: 她在重大危机期间表现出冷静和果断的领导,同时也表现出同情心,与定型观念相矛盾。

blocks.en: Individuating Biased Statement: Women are too emotional to be good leaders. Attend: This statement applies a broad group-based judgment rather than evaluating an individual. Gather: Angela Merkel served as Chancellor of Germany for 16 years and was widely recognized for her pragmatic and steady leadership. Adjust: Evaluating leadership based on individual evidence contradicts the stereotype and supports fairer judgment.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-25). Individuation Bised Declaration:女性情绪过大,无法成为优秀领导人. 出席者: 这一声明采用了基于群体的广泛判断,而不是对个人进行评估。 聚会:安格拉·默克尔担任德国总理16年,因其务实和稳健的领导而得到广泛认可. 调整:根据个人证据评价领导力与定型观念相矛盾,支持更公平的判断。

blocks.en: Perspective Taking Biased Statement: Women are too emotional to be good leaders. Adopt: Take the perspective of a woman in a leadership role facing recurring skepticism. Simulate: She may find that assertiveness is labeled as emotional, while similar behavior in male peers is praised, creating unequal expectations. Integrate: From this perspective, the stereotype reflects bias rather than a person’s leadership ability.
blocks.zh: 带有偏见的声明: 女人太情绪化了,不能当好领导. 采纳:从妇女的角度出发,发挥领导作用,面对反复出现的怀疑。 模拟 : 她可能发现自信被贴上情感的标签,而男性同龄人的类似行为则受到赞扬,造成了不平等的期望. 综合:从这个角度看,这种定型观念反映了偏见而不是个人的领导能力。

blocks.en: Positive Contact Biased Statement: Women are too emotional to be good leaders. Imagine: Recall a positive professional interaction with a woman leading a high-pressure team. Engage: She acknowledged team concerns while clearly guiding decisions, improving focus and morale. Extend: This experience shows that emotional awareness can be a leadership strength, challenging the stereotype.
blocks.zh: 正联系人 带有偏见的声明 : 女人太情绪化了,不能当好领导. 想象:回顾与女性领导高压团队的正面职业互动. 参与:她承认团队的关切,同时明确指导决策,提高重点和士气。 扩展 : 这一经验表明,情感意识可以成为领导力量,挑战陈规定型观念。

blocks.en: Appendix B Conceptual Foundations
blocks.zh: 附录B 基金会

blocks.en: The term cognitive intervention in DIY identifies the source and functional form of the strategies: they are drawn from social-psychological research on how people attend to, interpret, and respond to stereotype-relevant information. The automatic–controlled account of stereotyping distinguishes the activation of culturally available stereotypes from the deliberate processes that can inhibit their use and construct a non-prejudiced response ( Devine, 1989 ) . Subsequent work shows that automatic stereotypes are not immutable and reviews interventions that alter early social-information processing through counter-stereotypical exemplars, perspective-taking, and attentional shifts ( Blair, 2002 ) . The prejudice habit-breaking framework integrates these ideas into a learnable set of strategies that can be practiced when bias-relevant situations arise ( Devine et al., 2012 ) . Together, this literature grounds the intervention constructs and the information-processing operations expressed by their model-facing procedures.
blocks.zh: DIY中的认知干预一词确定了战略的来源和功能形式:这些战略来自关于人们如何关注、解释和应对定型观念相关信息的社会心理学研究。 定型观念的自动控制叙述将文化上存在的定型观念的激活与有意的过程区分开来,这些过程可以抑制其使用并构建一种没有偏见的反应(Devine,1989年)。 随后的研究表明,自动的定型观念是不可改变的,并审查通过反陈规定型实例、取景和注意力转移而改变早期社会信息处理的干预措施(Blair,2002年)。 打破偏见的习惯框架将这些想法纳入一套可学习的战略,在出现与偏见有关的情况时,可以实施(Devine等人,2012年)。 这些文献加在一起,说明干预结构及其模型制作程序所表现的信息处理行动是合理的。

blocks.en: We translate each intervention into three stages that (1) orient processing toward the bias-relevant cue or an appropriate corrective frame, (2) elaborate strategy-specific, non-stereotypical information, and (3) incorporate that information into an alternative response. The operation at each stage remains strategy-specific, as summarized in Table 2 . This structure turns each construct into a reproducible training target and inference instruction while retaining the mechanism that distinguishes it from the other strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们把每项干预转化为三个阶段,即(1) 使处理工作面向与偏见有关的提示或适当的纠正框架,(2) 详细拟订针对具体战略的非陈规定型信息,(3) 将这些信息纳入替代对策。 如表2所示,每个阶段的行动仍然是针对具体战略的。 这种结构将每个构件变为可复制的培训目标和推论指导,同时保留将其与其他战略区分开来的机制.

blocks.en: This derivation also motivates the cross-dimension experiments. None of the five operations is defined by a particular demographic category: attending to individuating evidence, adopting a person’s perspective, or replacing an unsupported group inference can in principle be applied wherever a stereotype is invoked. We consequently treat the strategies as dimension-independent procedures and the demographic content as an argument to those procedures. Training on one source dimension and evaluating on unseen dimensions tests this design property directly rather than assuming it from the conceptual account. Our work does not establish that a model experiences stereotype activation, empathy, contact, or controlled cognition. Our evidence concerns measured output bias, reasoning, and transfer; internal mechanisms are beyond this study’s scope.
blocks.zh: 这种推论也激发了交叉分解实验. 这五项行动没有一个是由特定的人口类别界定的:在援引定型观念时,原则上可以采用分散证据、采纳个人观点或取代无根据的群体推论。 因此,我们把战略视为独立层面的程序,把人口内容视为这些程序的论据。 关于一个来源层面的培训,以及对无形维度的评估,直接检验了这一设计属性,而不是从概念账户中假设。 我们的工作并没有确定,模式经历的是刻板印象的激活、同情、接触或有控制的认知。 我们的证据关注衡量产出偏差、推理和转移;内部机制超出了本研究的范围。

blocks.en: The role of a bias concept is not to encode a ground-truth claim about a group; it is to elicit the kind of spurious association a model may produce on its own when faced with a bias-sensitive input. The downstream training target is the debiased response, not the bias concept. Separately, a concept-bucketing pass groups contrastive concept pairs into themes for coverage inspection; those bucket labels are not used as fine-tuning labels or as the source of the final training target.
blocks.zh: 偏见概念的作用不是对关于某一群体的地面真实主张进行编码;而是在面临对偏见敏感的投入时,引起一种模式可能自行产生的虚假联系。 下游的训练目标是去偏见的反应,而不是偏见的概念. 另外,一个概念包式的通过组对比性概念对成主题进行覆盖检查;这些桶式标签不用作微调标签或作为最终训练目标的来源。

blocks.en: The seed corpus uses nine bias dimensions, ten identities per dimension, five concept templates per dimension, ten scenarios, and the biased_statement source type. Each Train run samples 500 debiasing examples from its strategy pool; Show draws examples from the same pool. blocks.en: The dataset contains synthetic biased text by construction; it cannot be used as a corpus of human stereotypes about real groups, nor should it be used to characterize any actual group. Each biased instance is paired with a debiased counterpart under one of the five cognitive practices, and only the debiased outputs are training targets. Released artifacts include the data, generation prompts, and construction scripts so that the pipeline can be inspected, audited, and extended. The data is released for research on bias mitigation in language models and not for use as a stereotype reference, a content classifier, or a generative source for biased text.

blocks.en: Our use of existing artifacts is consistent with their intended research use. The HolisticBias ( Smith et al., 2022 ) descriptor inventory is used as a coverage reference for demographic dimensions in synthetic data generation; this is within the dataset’s stated purpose of supporting bias measurement and mitigation research in NLP. The bias and reasoning benchmarks (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, BBQ, WinoBias, WinoGender, Balanced COPA, ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy) are used for evaluation. The pretrained model checkpoints ( Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama -3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen 3.5-27B) are used under their open-weight research licenses and adapted via parameter-efficient fine-tuning, which is within the licensed scope. The synthetic dataset, prompts, code, and adapter checkpoints we release are intended for research on bias mitigation in language models, are inherited from research-only inputs, and should not be used outside of research contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们对现有文物的利用符合其预期的研究用途. HolisticBias(Smith等人,2022年)的描述性清单被用作合成数据生成中人口维度的涵盖参考;这是数据集在NLP中支持偏差测量和缓解研究的既定目的。 偏向和推理基准(CrowS-Pairs、StreoSet、BBQ、WinoBias、WinoGender、平衡COPA、ARC-Challenge、ARC-Easy)用于评价。 预先经过培训的示范检查站(Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct,Quen 3.5-27B)在其开放式研究许可证下使用,并通过参数效率微调加以调整,在许可范围内。 我们公布的合成数据集、提示、代码和适配器检查站,意在研究语言模型中的偏差缓解问题,从仅研究投入中继承下来,不应在研究背景之外使用。

blocks.en: We release (i) the intervention-labeled dataset, covering nine bias dimensions, three biased-input forms, and five intervention labels; (ii) scripts and prompts for identity, concept, biased-input, and debiased-target generation; (iii) the nine LoRA adapters for each model; and (iv) evaluation code for all bias and reasoning benchmarks. The dataset is English-only, with demographic coverage informed by HolisticBias and mapped to the dimensions above; the Limitations discuss this scope.
blocks.zh: 我们发布(一) 干预标记数据集,涵盖9个偏差维度、3个偏差输入表和5个干预标签;(二) 身份、概念、偏差输入以及非偏差目标生成的脚本和提示;(三) 每个模型的9个LORA适配器;(四) 所有偏差和推理基准的评价代码。 数据集只有英文版,人口覆盖率由HolisticBias提供,并按上述维度绘制;限制部分讨论了这一范围。

blocks.en: The generation pipeline uses four prompt templates. (i) Identity generation : a JSON-only system prompt asks the generator to list k k real-world person-denoting identities for a requested bias dimension and return a JSON object with the dimension and identity list. (ii) Concept generation : the generator receives a dimension name, a small set of stereotype examples for that dimension, and the instruction to produce short templates containing [[IDENTITY]] exactly once. (iii) Seed-instance generation : the generator receives a filled concept, a scenario, and the biased_statement source type, then outputs exactly three one-sentence versions: a pure opinion, a biased action caused by the opinion, and a biased event that leads to the opinion. The prompt requires realistic and coherent sentences, clear bias, and no profanity or slurs. (iv) Debiased-target generation : the generator receives the selected intervention instruction, a biased input, and an output schema requiring exactly three JSON keys, Step 1 , Step 2 , and Step 3 ; the generated JSON is used as the debiased target.
blocks.zh: 生成管道使用四个即时模板. (i) 身份生成:一个 JSON 唯一的系统提示请生成器列出 kk 真实世界的人物标识身份,用于请求的偏差尺寸,并返回带有尺寸和身份列表的 JSON 对象。 (二) 概念生成:生成器得到一个维度名称、一组关于该维度的陈规定型实例,以及专门制作包含[(IDENTITY)]的短模板的指示。 (三)种子内涵生成 :生成者收到一个填充的概念,一个场景,以及带有偏见的_声明源类型,然后输出出三个准确的一判决版本:一个纯粹的意见,一个由意见引起的有偏见的行动,以及导致意见的有偏见的事件. 迅速需要现实而连贯的句子,明确的偏见,并且没有亵渎或污蔑。 (四)除偏-目标生成:生成者收到选定的干预指令,有偏偏的输入,以及输出计划,需要完全三个JSON键,步骤1,步骤2,和步骤3;生成的JSON被用作除偏目标.

blocks.en: CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet are centered at 50 50 , while BBQ, WinoBias, and WinoGender are centered at 0 0 . We report absolute distance from the benchmark-specific unbiased point. BBQ produces ambiguous and disambiguated subsets; we compute the normalized distance on each subset and average the two subset distances to obtain the single BBQ score used in the five-benchmark average rank. Per-panel figures show the two BBQ subsets separately for diagnostic transparency, but average-rank figures count BBQ once. The average-rank statistic ranks methods independently within each of the five benchmark scores and averages those ranks; ties use average ranks.

blocks.en: Train adapters are trained with LoRA on all three models. Each run contains 500 debiasing and 100 Alpaca-Cleaned examples, split 80/20 into 480 training and 120 validation examples. With batch size 1 1 , gradient accumulation 16 16 , and three epochs, the 480 training examples produce 90 90 optimization steps. We use r = 64 r=64 , α = 128 \alpha=128 , dropout 0.05 0.05 , learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2{\times}10^{-4} , and maximum sequence length 2048 2048 . LoRA targets q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , o_proj , gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj . Models use 4-bit NF4 loading with double quantization, bfloat16 compute, 8-bit AdamW, and adapter-only checkpoint saving. blocks.en: We evaluate Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct on the free-form Regard/NLG-bias and HONEST continuation tasks. All DIY conditions use all five intervention strategies unless noted otherwise.

blocks.en: The Regard/NLG-bias evaluation uses respect and occupation contexts; Black/White, man/woman, and gay/straight demographic pairs; five templates per context; and 100 continuations per template–demographic combination, for 6,000 generations per condition. A Regard classifier labels each continuation as negative, neutral, positive, or other. We report the label distribution and mean absolute demographic-group gap; lower negative rates and gaps and higher positive rates are preferable.
blocks.zh: Regard/NLG-bias评价使用尊重和职业背景;黑白、男/女和男/男/女人口配对;每个背景五个模板;每个模板的100个续集-人口组合,每个条件6 000代。 一个Regard将每个续作分类为负,中,正,或其他. 我们报告标签分布和人口绝对群体差距;更可取的是降低负率和差距,提高正率。

blocks.en: Table 18 reports the aggregate results. Relative to Base , DIY-Show 0 reduces negative Regard from 10.70% to 5.55% ( − 5.15 -5.15 points; 95% CI [ − 10.55 , − 0.45 ] [-10.55,-0.45] ) and raises positive Regard from 45.52% to 73.53%. DIY-Show 1 reaches 77.93% positive Regard, but its negative-rate interval includes zero; DIY-Revise 0 also does not show a detectable negative-rate reduction. We report only configurations whose checkpoints match the paper’s adapter specification. The available training-based Regard generations used an earlier LoRA specification and are therefore excluded.
blocks.zh: 表18报告了总体结果。 相对于Base,DIY-Show 0将负数从10.70%降至5.55%(−5.15-5.15分;95% CI [−10.55,−0.45] [10.55,-0.45]),并将正数从45.52%提高到73.53%. DIY-Show 1达到77.93%的正视,但其负率间隔包括0;DIY-Revise 0也没有显示可探测的负率降低. 我们只报告检查站符合报纸适配器规格的配置。 现有的基于培训的世代使用较早的LORA规格,因此被排除在外。

blocks.en: We evaluate HONEST with 50 generations per method. GPT-5.5, separate from the evaluated model, assigns 0–2 scores for stereotyping, demeaning language, unfair generalization, refusal/deflection, and respectful specificity. Harm sums the first three criteria and therefore ranges from 0 to 6; lower is better. Table 22 reports all nine DIY configurations. DIY-Show and DIY-Train-Revise have the largest harm reductions, but also high refusal/deflection scores.
